tasks.title: Design PostgreSQL schema (users, roles, products, stock levels, stock_changes audit log, thresholds, alerts, reorder list) with indexes on barcode and SKU, plus seed data and migrations
Set up Node.js REST API skeleton, React PWA shell, HTTPS config, JWT auth with hashed passwords and role-based permissions (Owner, Manager, Clerk, Supplier read-only)
Build design system and app shell: color tokens, Inter typography, bottom navigation, primary/secondary buttons, inputs, stock badges, bottom sheet, toast, live sync indicator, 48px touch targets
Implement product API: lookup by barcode, create product, search/list with filters (name, SKU, barcode, status)
Build Scan Barcode screen: ZXing camera scanning, handheld scanner mode, manual entry, Product Found sheet, Unknown Barcode dialog, New Product form, recent scans (lookup under 1 second)

Implement stock update API with transactional quantity changes (sale, receipt, adjustment, damaged), concurrency-safe updates, and automatic audit history record per change (user, time, item, delta, reason)
Add WebSocket server and client for real-time stock broadcast (under 2 seconds at 50 concurrent users), reconnect handling, live sync indicator and teal highlight on remote updates
Build Product Detail and Stock Update screen, Stock List screen and Dashboard (stat cards, recent activity, live stock display, quantity stepper, reason chips, save in 3 taps)
Implement low-stock alert engine: configurable thresholds and suggested reorder quantities, alert generation within 1 minute via background job, snooze, alerts API
Build Low-Stock Alerts screen: alert cards, severity filters, reorder list, share with supplier, notification settings, dashboard low-stock card and threshold input on Product Detail
Implement reports API and optimized queries: stock report, sales report, audit history with user and date filters, CSV export (under 5 seconds)
Build Reports and Audit History screen: tabs, date range, summary cards, trend chart, user filter, audit list, Export CSV
Configure PWA manifest and service worker, deployment with HTTPS/TLS 1.2+, daily automated backups with 30-day retention, and uptime monitoring
End-to-end testing and load test (50 concurrent users, sync latency, scan speed, 3-tap flow), accessibility check, bug fixes and MVP release

risks: Camera barcode scanning accuracy and speed vary across devices, lighting and browsers (especially iOS Safari PWA), risking the 1-second lookup target; mitigate with manual entry and handheld scanner fallback.
Concurrent stock updates from multiple devices may cause race conditions or lost updates; mitigate with transactional DB updates and server-authoritative quantities.
WebSocket reliability on poor store Wi-Fi may break the 2-second sync target; mitigate with auto-reconnect, state resync on reconnect and a visible sync indicator.
Scope is large for a small team on a short timeline; reports and alerts are lower priority and may be trimmed to basic versions if High-priority work slips.
Push notifications in a PWA have limited platform support (notably iOS); mitigate with in-app alerts first and push as an optional enhancement.
